department: Department of Chemistry (College of Arts & Sciences)

deadline.value: The 2027-01-15 date is for a teaching-fellowship, not PhD admission, so it is not used.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are not required for the graduate program, so no Chemistry Subject test is needed.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required for applicants seeking admission to the graduate program.

supervisor.value: Applicants describe the research advisors they envision working with; no pre-admission agreement is stated.
supervisor.quote: Please write approximately 500 words describing the research advisors whom you envision working with

funding.value: Teaching fellowships are offered with a preference date and only while positions remain.
funding.quote: applications received after this date will be considered for teaching fellowships until all positions have been awarded

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's is the minimum; post-master's applicants are also considered.
entry_route.quote: Admission for graduate study at Drexel University requires a four-year bachelor's degree

also.quote: Applicants for post-master's status must show potential for further study

app_fee.value: The chemistry page states an application fee of $65 U.S.
app_fee.quote: Please note, an application fee of $65 U.S. is required.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for the chemistry PhD.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required for applicants seeking admission to the graduate program.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL internet test minimum 100 (the page also lists 600 paper and 250 computer scores).

ielts_min.value: The chemistry department requires IELTS overall 7.5, above the 7.0 on the physics, biology and math pages.

notes: Essay and two recommendation letters are required. The chemistry PhD deadline table is split in the page text and is not quoted.
name: PhD in Chemistry
